RCMK:

• Kalakar Hule Mahila Shakti Vocational Centre
• ⁠25 students for tailoring course which is being taught 3 times a week
• ⁠There were 15 students learning jewellery making until June 2026 - now awaiting the commencement of the advanced jewellery making course
• ⁠In the tailoring class the students have learnt to design and stitch various types of clothing included those for children and women
